Estimated Time to Win: [277.5s - 295s]

Time to win varies from:

  1. Size of battle party
  2. Latency
  3. Level of execution
  4. Level of counters

Overview:

This is a challenging solo which focuses on, maximizing energy gained on Necrozma Dawn Wings while minorly using Mega Gengar as a leadoff and Executor.

Main Strategy:

Mega Gengar:

  1. Leadoff: Use Mega Gengar's Shadow Ball to quickly make Azelf aggressive. As a result, Azelf may begin casting charge moves sooner for NDW to absorb. When a heavy charge move occurs, Future Sight or Fire Blast, switch to NDW.
  2. Executor: Mega Gengar can optionally be swapped in to deal a fast knock out blow with shadow ball. This would otherwise outspeed the slower Moongeist Beam.

Necrozma Dawn Wings:

  1. Each NDW casts 2-3 Moongeist Beams
  2. It can comfortably tank: 2-3 Future sights, 1-2 fire blasts and a healthy amount of swifts.
  3. Once the active NDW is too low, swap to the next one. Do not allow it to faint.
  4. If using TPC, NDW runs Psycho Cut. Otherwise Shadow Claw is less DPS but still viable.


Advanced DPS Tips:

Tick Perfect Cast [TPC]: DPS Increase: ~4.5%

  1. While not required, it is extremely helpful to time each Moongeist beam, especially if running the high energy focused Psycho Cut.
  2. In order to TPC, simply slow down your taps as energy nears 100. Wait a brief moment after the 2nd to last tap and then cast Moongeist Beam. If this strategy isn't preferred, Shadow Claw may be the better option. Time Save: ~10-15s

Substitute [Sub]: Increased Consistency

  1. Against Future Sight, Mega Gengar is in danger of being 1 shot when playing in the first slot after the first rejoin. Creating a second battle party (with the same pokemon) where Necrozma Dawn Wings is in the first spot helps overcome this issue.

Overview:

This is a moderate level solo which focuses on, maximizing energy absorbed by Necrozma Dawn Wings while optionally using Mega Gengar as a leadoff and Executor. Be advised Future Sight will 1 hit k0 Mega Gengar. If using it, it is ideal to either dodge or switch it out on Future Sight Cast.

Depending on your battle party size this will range anywhere from 1 to 4 rejoins.

Main Strategy

1) Necrozma Dawn Wings will contribute the majority of the DPS.

  1. Each NDW casts 2-3 Moongeist Beams
  2. It can comfortably tank: 2-3 Future sights, 1-2 fire blasts and a healthy amount of swifts.
  3. Once the active NDW is too low to cast another Moongeist Beam, swap to the next one. Do not let it faint.
  4. Dodging on Necrozma Dawn Wings is NOT ENCOURAGED. Over investment into survivability will put you behind pace.

2) Rejoin the raid efficiently using Hyper Potions with preset battle parties.
